capture.note: private capture directory is not part of this fixture; its scan-status.json hash is recorded here

advisory-report.json.origin: assembled: rows/families/records from the capture session's advisory views (addendum/), SBOM lists re-derived from syft-sbom.cdx.json

bombridge-result.json.origin: original capture bytes (oracle only; recomputed by replay and compared)

source-inputs.json.origin: reconstructed by reconstruct_source_inputs.py (one fetch of the full SHA) and verified against the capture's tree_sha, listing_sha256, file_count, byte_count and skipped entries

limits.advisory_report: the OSV log stores digests only; record bodies and lockfile rows come from the capture session's own advisory views (inventory lists are capped at 10 per row by that view)
limits.not_replayed: no scanner, OSV, GitHub or OpenAI call is made by the replay

record_bodies.reason: these families belong to lockfile-only rows, which the advisory view does not expose; only label/severity/summary/withdrawn survive

limits.source_inputs: the full 3337-file listing was reconstructed with the original export rules and verified against tree_sha and listing_sha256 (source-inputs.json)
limits.worker_paths: syft-sbom.cdx.json and cdxgen-cbom.cdx.json contain ephemeral worker paths of the form /spool/in/<job-token>/src/...; kept unmodified so the original hashes stay valid
